premises.text: Microsatellites are revolutionizing how we use space to impact life on Earth.
premises.evidence_span: they are revolutionizing how we use space to impact life here on Earth

premises.text: Companies using microsatellites face significant delays and complications in launching.
premises.evidence_span: adding up all these pain points can lead to two and a half years between when a launch is scheduled and when a satellite is operational

premises.text: Dedicated launch services are needed for microsatellite customers to avoid compromises.
premises.evidence_span: what customers need is the experience that you and I know is ride-sharing, where you can call up a ride that takes you where you want to go, when you want to get there

premises.text: Launching rockets from high altitudes can reduce costs and size.
premises.evidence_span: if you could launch your rocket above 95% of the Earth's atmosphere, you could make it small enough to cost-effectively launch an individual customer

premises.text: Regulus is a fully reusable and autonomous vehicle for launching rockets from high altitudes.
premises.evidence_span: Regulus is a fully reusable and autonomous vehicle that allows us to launch rockets from 60,000 feet in altitude

premises.text: The platform can support a high launch frequency and quick turnaround for microsatellite launches.
premises.evidence_span: Leo Aerospace can provide a launch within a matter of weeks to any low-Earth orbit and support a very high launch frequency

premises.text: The technology has potential applications beyond launching rockets, including testing for NASA.
premises.evidence_span: we realized that our platform could do more than just launch rockets at altitude

value.text: Microsatellite customers gain access to dedicated, efficient launch services.
value.evidence_span: Finally, microsatellite customers will have the dedicated launch service they've been asking for
